professionalSummary.text: Built and maintained Airflow pipelines for monthly churn model retraining and nightly scoring of 48,000 accounts with task-level alerts.
professionalSummary.witness: built the Airflow DAGs that retrain the churn model monthly and score 48,000 accounts every night, with retries and failure alerts on each task.

professionalSummary.text: Documented 70 feature definitions in the feature store with owner, refresh schedule, and SQL details, reviewed with requesting analysts.
professionalSummary.witness: Documented 70 feature definitions in the feature store, each with an owner, a refresh schedule and the SQL behind it, and reviewed new features with the analysts who requested them.

professionalSummary.text: Promoted churn-scoring pipeline from staging to production after two-week parallel run comparing nightly scores account by account.
professionalSummary.witness: Promoted the churn-scoring pipeline from the staging project to the production project after a two-week parallel run in staging that compared the nightly scores account by account.

professionalSummary.text: Set up data-quality checks on nightly feature loads and weekly drift alerts on score distribution with on-call paging for threshold breaches.
professionalSummary.witness: Set up data-quality checks on each nightly feature load and a weekly drift alert on the score distribution, paging the data team's on-call channel when thresholds were crossed.

professionalSummary.text: Met monthly with customer-success leads to explain score changes and pass high-risk account comments to data science team.
professionalSummary.witness: Met the customer-success leads monthly to explain score changes and noted their comments on accounts flagged as high risk, passing them to the data science team.

experienceHighlights.text: Promoted pipeline to production after two-week parallel run in staging, with account-by-account comparison.
experienceHighlights.witness: Promoted the churn-scoring pipeline from the staging project to the production project after a two-week parallel run in staging that compared the nightly scores account by account.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented 70 feature definitions with SQL, owner, and refresh schedule, reviewed with requesting analysts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Documented 70 feature definitions in the feature store, each with an owner, a refresh schedule and the SQL behind it, and reviewed new features with the analysts who requested them.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Monitoring runbook for churn-scoring pipeline approved by head of data, detailing drift thresholds, data-quality checks, alert routing, and re-run steps for failed scores.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the monitoring runbook for the churn-scoring pipeline, giving the drift thresholds, the data-quality checks, the alert routing and the steps for re-running a failed nightly score, as approved by the head of data.

skills.witness: built the Airflow DAGs that retrain the churn model monthly and score 48,000 accounts every night, with retries and failure alerts on each task.
Documented 70 feature definitions in the feature store, each with an owner, a refresh schedule and the SQL behind it, and reviewed new features with the analysts who requested them.
Promoted the churn-scoring pipeline from the staging project to the production project after a two-week parallel run in staging that compared the nightly scores account by account.
Set up data-quality checks on each nightly feature load and a weekly drift alert on the score distribution, paging the data team's on-call channel when thresholds were crossed.
